bot.name: PurpleWave
bot.description: An all-race opponent by Dan Gant with a broad strategy repertoire, precise unit control, and persistent opponent history.

formats.notes: sb.6 has natural all-race 1v1 results on x86/x64 and installed/UI reset checks. Terran factory tests exposed unsupported Lift and Spider Mines commands; production approval withheld. docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Opponent history, placement caches, and logs stay in the isolated profile. Reset read and write to the empty baseline to clear learning; compatible history is preserved across updates.

localDistribution.evidence: Scoped source, runtime effects, source-delivery and complete notice review of exact sb.6 build. Public competition remains unreviewed. docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Separate from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Production blocked: Terran factory games on x86/x64 repeatedly hit unsupported Lift (kind 24) and Spider Mines (Use_Tech_Position kind 41, tech 3).
Current ShieldBattery local/practice launch and BWAPI bridge are development-only; production runtime enablement requires a separate upstream change.
Natural 1v1 results cover assigned races on x86/x64; Random, other formats, unusual maps and exhaustive late-game behavior remain unverified.
Signed local HTTPS catalog installation, integrity rejection and actual UI reset passed on x86/x64; public staging/CDN publication was not performed.
Scoped source/runtime tracing is not an OS sandbox. Human difficulty and public competition remain unreviewed.

sourceReview.evidence: Exact sb.6 source/JAR delta and packaged-source offline rebuild reviewed; unchanged dependencies retain scoped source/native review. docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md
